description: Change settings of the caller's autario apps: AI Visibility prompts and assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity), project board items, and the public developer profile.

action.description: Which operation to run. prompts_list = AI Visibility prompts and assistant selection of a brand, needs brand; prompts_add = store new AI Visibility prompts, needs brand; prompts_remove = set AI Visibility prompts inactive, needs brand; prompts_set_assistants = choose which assistants a brand runs, needs brand; project_create = add a project; project_update = change a project; objective_create = add an objective; objective_update = change an objective; key_result_create = add a key result; key_result_update = change a key result; developer_profile = your public developer profile.

aggregation.description: For key results: how its countries add up to a region. sum (default) for counts and money, average for rates and levels, none lists the countries without a total.

assistants.description: For "set_assistants": the full list of assistants this brand runs from now on (replaces the current selection). An empty array returns to the app default.

items.description: A provider id from the app registry, for example openai, anthropic, gemini, perplexity.

baseline.description: For key results: where the number started. Attainment runs from baseline to target.

bio.description: Up to 280 characters about you or what you build.

brand.description: Brand name or brand id (required). With several brands on the account the name must match one of them exactly (case-insensitive); the tool answers with the list when it does not.

brief.description: A short description of what the project is.

budget_amount.description: Budget. Needs budget_currency. Never converted between currencies.

budget_currency.description: Three letter currency code of the budget, e.g. EUR.

commitment.description: For objectives: committed (expected at 1.0) or aspirational (0.7 is a good outcome). Changes the status rule of its key results, never a number.

contributors.description: Everyone else working on it. These names are what the person axis groups by, together with the owner.

country.description: The region or country that runs it, in the account's own words ("DACH", "Nordics"), not an ISO code.

country_column.description: For key results with dataset_id: the column that names the country of a row (autario_entity when the dataset has it). value_column is then read per country; a country the dataset lacks keeps its typed value.

country_values.description: For key results: the value per country, [{ country, current, target }]; country as a name or ISO code. A region total uses these; several countries without values are never split.

country.description: The country, as an ISO code (DEU or DE) or its English name. Listed once per key result; an unknown name is refused with a sentence.

current.description: The value this country has today, in the unit of the key result. Omit when unknown; a row without current and target is dropped.

target.description: The value this country should reach, in the unit of the key result. The region target is derived from these by aggregation.

dataset_id.description: For key results: the dataset the value is read from (any dataset on this account).

direction.description: For key results: whether higher or lower is better. Default increase.

display_name.description: Name shown on the page, up to 60 characters. Defaults to the handle.

ends_on.description: For objectives: end of that window, YYYY-MM-DD.

filter_column.description: For key results: optional column to filter the dataset on.

filter_value.description: For key results: the value filter_column must have.

format.description: Output wire format for this MCP call. Default 'toon' (Token-Oriented Notation, fewest tokens, best for tabular rows). 'compact' = minified JSON. 'json' = pretty JSON for readability. The REST API always returns JSON regardless.

function.description: The function that contributes it ("Marketing", "Supply chain").

group.description: For "list": which axis the cards are folded on. Default "okr", which is the axis that answers "does everything we do pay into something we agreed".

guardrail_note.description: For key results: how this number could be reached the wrong way.

guards_id.description: For key results: makes this key result a GUARDRAIL of that key result.

handle.description: Your public handle, set once (lowercase, 3 to 30 characters). Omit it after it is set.

id.description: The id of the thing to read or change: the project for "get" and "update", the objective for "update_objective", the key result for "update_key_result".

ids.description: For "remove": the prompt ids to set inactive. An id that is not on this brand answers not found and the others still go through.

items.description: A prompt id as returned by action "list".

impact.description: Expected impact as a judgement: 1 low, 2 some, 3 clear, 4 high, 5 very high.

key_result_id.description: The id of the key result this project pays into. "list" returns the linkable ones in `key_results`; pass one of their `id` values. Omit for work that pays into nothing yet, which is exactly what the OKR axis is there to make visible.

kind.description: Is this a project with an end, or recurring day-to-day work? Default "project".

manual_value.description: For key results: the current value typed by hand. Shown as typed by hand; prefer dataset_id + value_column.

objective_id.description: For "create_key_result": the objective it belongs to. "objectives" lists them.

owner.description: The one person accountable for it.

parent_id.description: The project this one is part of. Projects nest at most three levels deep (programme, workstream, piece); a move that would make a fourth level or a loop is refused with a sentence. Parent progress, when the parent has none of its own, is the mean of its children and says so.

progress_pct.description: Progress in percent, 0 to 100, set by a person. Never derived from milestones or dates.

prompts.description: For "add": the prompts to store. Each item is {text, topic?, category?}. The server applies the brand rule per item and reports what it stored, what it reclassified and what it refused, with the reason.

category.description: Optional question type. direct (default) = category buying question, never your own brand; application = a problem described in the user's words, no brand and no product category; comparison = two named options weighed, brands allowed.

text.description: The question exactly as a buyer would type it into an assistant.

topic.description: Optional topic label the prompt is grouped under in the app (free text, for example "Agency reporting").

resources_url.description: A link to where the actual work lives (a drive folder, a board, a doc). http(s) only.

sort.description: For "list": the order of cards inside each group. "board" (default) puts off-track work first; "effort_impact" orders by impact (5 to 1) then effort (fewest days first), unrated work last. No combined score is computed.

spent_amount.description: Money spent so far, typed by a person, in budget_currency.

stage.description: Where it stands. A new project starts "active" (running); when the board owner switched on "New projects need admin approval", a non-admin's new project starts at "inbox" (pending review) and only an admin moves it out. "long_list" = agreed, not started; "done" = finished.

starts_on.description: For objectives: start of the window its key results are paced against, YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: The traffic light, set by a person: on track, at risk, off track.

target.description: For key results: the number that counts as done. Required on create.

target_date.description: Target date, YYYY-MM-DD. "Due in N days" / "overdue by N days" is derived from it on every read and never stored.

target_reason.description: For "update_key_result": why the target moves (ten characters or more). Required whenever `target` changes; the change is kept in the key result history.

unit.description: For key results: the unit the number is in.

value_column.description: For key results: the column of dataset_id that holds the number.

x_url.description: Your X profile, on x.com or twitter.com.

name: app_settings
